summary: Preserve explicit service-account isolation with serialized secure-storage transactions, non-mutating previews, guarded MCP arguments, read-only profile access, and policy-gated exact document reads.
reason: Automation needs named authentication without shell-global token changes, plaintext persistence, argv exposure, or silent account fallback. Document consumers need exact references and an explicit reveal gate instead of fuzzy lookup or automatic downloads.
validated_outcome: Regression coverage verifies account selection conflicts, child-only authentication, missing-token and Connect conflicts, profile/MCP exclusion, safe previews and rollback, cross-process lifecycle serialization, malformed MCP parameter rejection, readonly profile access, token redaction, and file-only exact-reference document reveal gates.
